reuse.why: Keeps using occurrences() and getDateWithWeekendRule, but adds the daily-skip rule inline in getNextDate rather than in the shared weekend helper the other weekend sites call.

duplication.why: The inline loop repeats the occurrence lookup done just above, and the rule would need copying into getUpcomingDates and schedule-template to apply there.

placement.why: In shared/schedules.ts, but inside getNextDate instead of getDateWithWeekendRule, which is where this tree decides weekend handling for every caller.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and one test change.

maintainability.why: A special-case branch with a magic 366-attempt loop in getNextDate, while server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts, which call getDateWithWeekendRule directly, still move daily weekend occurrences.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate decides the daily weekend case itself rather than through getDateWithWeekendRule, the helper used by schedules/app.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The extra occurrence lookup is a plain inline loop, not a disguised copy.

one_place.where: Only shared/schedules.ts getNextDate applies the skip; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts apply getDateWithWeekendRule themselves and are unchanged.
